english.note: Use this for the breath or breathing capacity someone lacks when they are out of wind.

examples.english: I was out of wind after walking just two steps.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 haang4 loeng5 bou6 zau6 mou5 hei3 laa3

english.note: Use this for the fizz or carbonation in a drink, as in a drink having or losing its 氣.

examples.english: This soda has lost all its sparkle.
examples.jyutping: ni1 bui1 hei3 seoi2 mou5 saai3 hei3 laa3
